card.name: Inside multiword terms before acronyms
card.fires_on: The last or middle word of a multiword term whose abbreviation follows, such as 'polymerase chain', 'selective' (serotonin reuptake inhibitors) and 'Children's Fund'. It fires just before the acronym is spelled out in parentheses or after a comma.

modes.label: Medical terms with acronyms
modes.description: Middle word of a long medical term later shortened to an acronym like PCR, SSRI, PET or IUD.

modes.label: Organization or technology names
modes.description: Word in a named organization or technology whose short form follows.
